latest.notes: New: Structured Audio segments. Build a reusable template once — an Open bed/jingle that ducks, a Voiceover read over it (an Online/External/FTP file by name like events-calendar), and a Close stinger — then drop it into a clock as a Structured Audio slot. It airs as ONE grouped element in the log via the existing bed talk-over engine, reserves a nominal length you set for hour timing, and skips the whole segment if the voiceover file is missing at air time.
